Dialogue_Wiki_Resolve_6B: Building a tavern and investing in ale production can pay off in the long run. You might even benefit from a moment of relaxation yourself. <style=N1>Lori's lips curl into an amused grin.</style>
Dialogue_Wiki_Resolve_7: There are also other ways of keeping villagers happy, such as upgrading Hearths, mitigating Hostility, or favoring one species over another. Although that last option can be a bit risky...
Dialogue_Wiki_Trade_1: Of course! <style=N1>Lori nods with a smile.</style>
Dialogue_Wiki_Trade_2: The first thing you’ll need is a Trading Post. Once it's set up, merchants will start coming to your settlement.
Dialogue_Wiki_Trade_3: You never know what they might bring, but they’ll almost always bring something useful, like food, building materials, tools, or blueprints.
Dialogue_Wiki_Trade_4: While amber is the main currency of the kingdom, we still barter in most cases. It's just more convenient to pay with the resources you've collected.
Dialogue_Wiki_Trade_5: The Guild's prices may seem a bit unfair at first, but they have to cover their travel costs somehow. Or at least, that's their official story...
Dialogue_Wiki_Trade_6: <style=N1>A hint of disgust can be seen on Lori's face.</style> Some Viceroys even believe this justifies attacking and robbing merchants... But it doesn't.
Effect_3OrderPicks_Desc: You have preferential treatment in the Queen's Court. The pool of order choices will increase by 1.
Effect_AdventofFlame_Desc: A sacred period for all members of the Church. Start with the Temple Blueprint. {0}
Effect_AlarmBells_Desc: The Brass Order's newest invention. All workers have a {0} higher chance of producing double yields for every {1} points of expected corruption per minute in the Ancient Hearth.
Effect_AllCampsUnlock_Child_Desc: Gathering speed is decreased by {0} until you use up at least {1} gathering node charges. Source: {2}.
Effect_AllCampsUnlock_Desc: A collection of architectural drafts from a very early period in the Citadel's history. Unlocks the advanced blueprints for the Foragers' Camp, Trappers' Camp, and Herbalists' Camp, but gathering speed is decreased by {0} until you use up at least {1} gathering node charges.
Effect_AmberForArcheology_Description: The Queen has decided to reward you for your exceptional achievements in science. Gain {0} for every completed stage of an archaeological discovery (excavation, conservation, reconstruction).
Effect_AmberForSeaMarrow_Desc: Some fossils contain valuable surprises. Gain {1} for every {0} produced.
Effect_AmberForWater_Desc: Apparently, amber-like crystals can be extracted from rainwater. Gain {0} every time you use {1} units of water in Rain Engines.
Effect_AmberPayment_Desc: The Crown requires you to contribute to the Royal Treasury. At the end of each Drizzle season, you will be asked to pay {1} {0} for every 3 villagers in your settlement. If you don't, 2 people will leave.
Effect_AmberPayment_Penalty_Desc: If you don't pay the tax, the Crown will recall {0} villagers back to the Citadel.
Effect_AncientTabletforEvents_Altar_Desc: Gain {0} for every {1} completed Glade Event.
Effect_AncientTabletforEvents_Desc: Gain {0} for every {1} completed Glade Events.
Effect_ArcheologyExtraBlueprint_Descript: The Queen has decided to reward you for your exceptional achievements in science. You receive an additional blueprint choice.
Effect_ArcheologyExtraCornerstone_Descri: The Queen has decided to reward you for your exceptional achievements in science. You receive an additional cornerstone choice.
Effect_AscensionHungerMultiplier_Desc: Famine outbreaks in your previous settlements have made the villagers particularly sensitive to food shortages. Every time villagers have nothing to eat during a break, they will gain two stacks of the Hunger effect instead of one.
Effect_AutomatonInAllMines_Desc: A rainpunk automaton will permanently occupy one workplace in every mine in your settlement.
Effect_AutomatonInWoodcutter_Desc: A Rainpunk Shredder will permanently occupy one workplace in every Woodcutters' Camp in the settlement. This large automaton can fell multiple trees without returning to camp. It doesn't eat, doesn't need to rest, and can't produce double yields.
Effect_Awakening_Desc: Upon awakening the Infected Mole, all dormant cysts activate and start to corrupt the Ancient Hearth. Cysts are vulnerable to Purging Fire when this effect is activated. Completing or canceling the event will not stop the corruption, and cysts will remain active until burned.
Effect_BankruptTraderPayment_Desc: The peddler is waiting for the agreed-upon sum of {1} {0}.
Effect_BatHousesUniqueBonus_Desc: In ancient times, Bats lived in vast underground halls, now overrun by the spawn of the Sealed Ones. Each time newcomers are accepted into the settlement, you gain {0} for every villager living in a house with this upgrade.
Effect_BatsBanish_Desc: Put a villager on trial and exile them ({1}).
Effect_BatsLowerFoodConsumption_Desc: Focused minds forget hunger. Villagers have a {0} chance of not consuming food during a break.
Effect_BatsResolveForDeaths_Desc: {0} Bats gain +{1} Resolve for every {2} members of other species who leave or die. One stack of Dedication is removed each time a Bat leaves or dies.
Effect_BatsShrineGlobalExtraProd_Desc: Those who remain in your settlement tremble, fearing they will be the next to be judged. The global chance of producing double yields is increased by {0}.
Effect_Biome_CaveInitialGoods_Desc: To ease the challenge of settling these harsh lands, the Crown has allocated additional resources for your caravan: {0} and {1}.
Effect_Biome_FarmsExtraProductionForFert: Farms have a {0} higher chance of producing double yields for every {1} obtained.
Effect_Biome_FasterTrade_Desc: With such a wealth of resources, trade flourishes. Every time you sell goods worth {2} Amber, traders arrive {0} quicker and trade routes become {1} faster.
Effect_Biome_GrassSpawner_Desc: The unusually soft ground in this region has been heavily worn down by rain. Naturally occurring patches of Fertile Soil cannot be found here.
Effect_BiomeEffect_BlackMarket_Desc: The Black Amber Syndicate offers its services to Viceroys ready to tap into the riches of these lands. You gain access to a new essential building: {0}.
Effect_BiomePoroProductivity_Desc: The great distance from the Citadel means that the well-being of this creature can often be the difference between life and death for the entire village. Villagers have a {0} higher chance of producing double yields.
Effect_BiomePoroResolve_Desc: Seeing this giant ball of fluff happy somehow makes the harsh reality surrounding the settlement a tiny bit easier to bear.
Effect_BlackMarketPayment_Desc: Delayed payment for goods acquired through the Black Market.
Effect_BlackMarketPaymentLeaving_Desc: The Black Amber Syndicate always collects its debts - one way or another. If you don't pay, {0} villagers will be kidnapped from your settlement.
Effect_BlazingAmber_Desc: Cursed amber crystals burn in our vaults. Hostility increases by {0} for every {1} in the settlement's Warehouse.
Effect_BlightBomb_Explosion_Desc: The Blight Bomb explosion will destroy everything within a {0} field radius.
Effect_BlightFighterSpeed_Desc: A more compact version of the famous Blight Fighter flamethrower. Blight Fighters move {0} quicker.
Effect_BlightRateforResolveReputation_Ch: Reputation from Resolve is generated {0} slower for the next {1} Reputation Points (source: {2}).
Effect_BlightRateforResolveReputation_De: A crystalline filter designed to mitigate the negative environmental impact of infused rainwater. Blightrot Cysts appear {0} slower when using rain engines, but Reputation from Resolve is generated {1} slower for the next {2} Reputation Points.
Effect_Blightrot_Desc: Pollution from industrial production feeds the growth of Blightrot Cysts. Deploy Blight Fighters to prevent your Hearths from becoming corrupted during the storm.
Effect_BlightrotCloning_Desc: Blood Flowers have a tendency to spread uncontrollably.
Effect_BlightrotedViceroyBox_Desc: At the beginning of {0} season in year {1}, a mysterious box will arrive in your settlement.
Effect_BlightrotedViceroyBox_Pack_Desc: Your thoughts wander for a moment as you open the box.
Effect_BlightrotHigh_Desc: The Blightrot's impact is significantly stronger. Cyst generation rate is increased by +150%, while the Hearth corrupts +100% quicker than normal.
Effect_BlightrotHighDifficulty_ShortDesc: Blightrot has a significantly greater impact.
Effect_BlightrotMedium_Desc: The Blightrot's impact is stronger. Cyst generation rate is increased by +100%, the Hearth corrupts +50% quicker than normal, and all effects that spawn Blightrot now add twice as many Cysts.
Effect_BlightrotResolve_Desc: The odor of Blood Flowers is making people feel sick.
Effect_BoxCrib_Desc: Miners have found a collapsed tunnel that leads to more mining veins: {0}.
Effect_BoxCrib_StaticDesc: Miners have found a collapsed tunnel that leads to more mining veins.
Effect_BrassOrderEngineersPayment_Desc: The airship crew is waiting for your delivery of {1} {0}.
Effect_BuildingAndPacksProductionHalved_: Recipes producing building materials and packs of goods give {0} less yield.
Effect_BuriedRiches_Desc: What was once taken must now be given back. All stored <sprite name="[valuable] amber"> Amber and <sprite name="[needs] wine"> Wine will be lost.
Effect_CallTrader_Random_Desc: Summons a random trader to your settlement. If used while another trader is present, the current one will depart.
Effect_CallTrader_Syndicate_Desc: A trader from the Black Amber Syndicate will visit your settlement, offering a variety of goods for sale - like clothing, cooked food, service goods, fuel, containers, metal, wildfire essence, blueprints, and perks.
Effect_CalmLands_Desc: The forest seems to have been soothed. Opening glades no longer increases Hostility.
Effect_CaptainCurse_Desc: The captain is the last to leave the ship. Destroys a random annual Cornerstone in your possession.
Effect_CaravanProd_Desc: Discovering the remains of a caravan has caused unrest in the settlement. All villagers have a {0} chance of destroying a production yield.
Effect_CaravanResolve_Desc: People are afraid of whatever destroyed the caravan.
Effect_CarryMoreForTablets_Desc: Stone tablets reveal the secrets of the ancients' strength. Scouts can carry {0} additional items and move {3} faster for every {1} {2} in the settlement's Warehouses.
Effect_CauldronResolve_Desc: Food tastes terrible due to contaminants from a leaking cauldron.
Effect_ChestPlunder_Desc: The convicts will not dare to attack your settlement, but they will loot whatever they can find in the forest. They destroy {0} random caches, prioritizing the ones in already discovered glades.
Effect_CloakedWandererVengeance_Desc: At the beginning of year {0}, the Cloaked Wanderer will have his revenge, killing {1} villagers.
Effect_CoalForCysts_Desc: Gain {1} for every {0} burned Blightrot Cysts.
Effect_ColdFlame_Desc: A blinding light is aimed directly at the settlement's Hearths, turning the Holy Fire into a cold flame. Hostility is increased by {0} for each Firekeeper in the settlement.
Effect_ConstructionCostForNodes_Desc: All buildings cost {0} less, but every newly discovered resource node has {1} fewer charges.
Effect_ConvictsResolve_Desc: Villagers have heard rumors of dangerous fugitives in the area. They are worried that desperate criminals might attack them.
Effect_CornerstonesLimit_Npc_Dialogue: "The laws of this place are clear, Viceroy. To claim a new cornerstone, you must first give up one you already possess. Balance must be maintained."
Effect_CorruptedSacrifice_Desc: An ancient jewel shimmers, revealing a glimmer of a faint underwater landscape. At the start of each Storm, if you have at least {1} points of expected corruption per minute, gain a permanent {0} bonus to the burning time of resources sacrificed in the Ancient Hearth.
Effect_CorruptionKill_Desc: The corruption weakens the Holy Flame's protective power and faint whispers from beyond turn into terrifying screams. Kills 3 random villagers.
Effect_CrumblingSeal_Desc: One of the seals is loosening its grip, leaking darkness upon this land. {0} season lasts {1} longer.
Effect_CystForFood_Desc: The Blightrot inside the Rainpunk Cauldron feeds on everything it encounters. For every {0} food produced, {1} Blightrot Cysts are spawned in the settlement.
Effect_CystForGlade_Desc: Trees communicate with each other through their roots, making the forest aware of your every move. Spawns {0} Blightrot Cysts every {2} seconds for every {1} Dangerous (<sprite name="dangerous">) or Forbidden Glade (<sprite name="forbidden">) discovered.
Effect_CystForHostility_Desc: The forest is merciless to those who exploit it. To protect itself, it may even sometimes ally with the Blightrot. Every {0} seconds, Blightrot Cysts ({1}) are spawned for each earned Hostility level.
Effect_CystsSpawn_Description: Large swarms of Blightrot migrate across the realm. Every third Clearance season, {0} Blightrot Cysts will appear in the settlement.
Effect_CystsSpawn_ShortDescription: Blightrot appears every third Clearance season.
Effect_DarkGateKill_Desc: Old tales talk of horrific, bloodthirsty apparitions emerging from beyond Dark Gates. Kills 10 random villagers.
Effect_DarkGateResolve_Desc: The mere presence of a Dark Gate makes the villagers fear for their lives.
Effect_DarkMist_Desc: A dark mist shrouds the menacing forest. Hostility from opened Dangerous Glades (<sprite name="dangerous">) is increased by {0}.
Effect_DepositsCharges_DefaultNestedDesc: +{0} charges to small gathering nodes, +{1} charges to large gathering nodes
Effect_DepositsCharges_NestedDescription: {0} charges to small gathering nodes, {1} charges to large gathering nodes
Effect_Desecrator_Desc: Gain {0} Hostility (Hostility scales based on difficulty). For every {1} seconds spent sacrificing goods in the Ancient Hearth, a villager dies. Sacrificing multiple resources at the same time will progress this effect's timer faster.
Effect_Disgrace_Desc: Somewhat... “unorthodox” culinary practices in one of your previous settlements have been brought to the Queen's attention. Start with {0} Impatience.
Effect_Effect_AdditionalImpatienceForDea: For the Queen, nothing is more important than her people. Losing villagers will add {0} more points to her Impatience.
Effect_EffectiveParasite_Desc: The Blightrot feeds on the tree's valuable nutrients, making new cysts much more resilient. Cysts burn for {0} seconds longer.
Effect_EggsForCysts_Desc: Blightrot spores aren't technically eggs, but they taste the same. You gain {0} when a Blightrot Cyst appears in your settlement.
Effect_EmbraceTheNight_Desc: The settlement is slowly engulfed in darkness. Each Blightrot Cyst increases Hostility by {0} points during the storm.
Effect_EngineCorrosion_Desc: Contaminated liquid gets inside Rain Engines through underground pipes. Using water in Rain Engines generates Blightrot Cysts {0} quicker.
Effect_Escape_Desc: When the specified time is up, the Treasure Stag will disappear into the forest.
Effect_EventTimeReduction10_Desc: A necklace made out of tiny bones. Scouts work {0} faster on Glade Events.
Effect_ExplorationTax_Desc: Taking advantage of the riches of this new land will cost you. You must pay {0} <sprite name="[valuable] amber"> Amber every time you discover a Small Glade, and {1} <sprite name="[valuable] amber"> Amber every time you discover a Dangerous (<sprite name="dangerous">) or Forbidden Glade (<sprite name="forbidden">) . Otherwise, 2 villagers will be recalled to the Citadel.
Effect_ExplorationTaxPayment_Big_Desc: You discovered a Dangerous (<sprite name="dangerous">) or Forbidden Glade (<sprite name="forbidden">). The Crown requires you to pay {1} {0}.
Effect_ExplorationTaxPayment_Small_Desc: You discovered a small glade. The Crown requires you to pay {1} {0}.
Effect_ExtendTradeRoutes_Description: Each neighboring town offers {0} additional Trade Route option(s)
Effect_Extractor_WaterPerMinAndTank_Desc: {0} Increases the tank capacity for every type of rainwater by {1}.
Effect_ExtraProdForConsumption_Desc: All workers have a {0} higher chance of producing double yields, but they also have a {1} higher chance of consuming twice as much food during a break.
Effect_ExtraProductionForCorruption_Desc: It was not you who removed this fragment, weakening the ancient seal - but you would still be executed on the spot if someone was to find it in your possession. Every Glade Event solved by making a decision marked as Corruption increases the chance of workers producing double yields by {1}.
Effect_ExtraProductionForRelicsInProgres: The courage and hard work of the town's scouts mobilizes other workers to be more productive. All workers get a {0} higher chance of doubling their production for every Dangerous Glade Event that is being worked on.
Effect_ExtraProductionForRelicsResolved_: Archaeologists have learned a lot about a long-lost culture by examining old ruins. All workers get a {0} higher chance of producing double yields for every {1} completed Dangerous and Forbidden Glade Events.
Effect_ExtraTraderMerch_Altar_Desc: Traders offer 1 additional perk or blueprint. You also gain an Active Ability that summons a trader to your settlement. This ability can be used from the Main Warehouse and has 5 uses.
Effect_ExtraTraderMerch_Desc: Traders will have 1 more perk or blueprint for sale.
Effect_FallenViceroyCommemoration_Desc: Villagers with their need for species-specific housing met will get an additional +2 to Resolve.
Effect_FamiliesGratitude_Desc: Relatives of your villagers send gifts for treating their family members well. Get {0} for every full Reputation Point obtained through high Resolve.
Effect_FasterCorruption_Desc: Your settlement's strongest and weakest point has become a direct target for the Blightrot. Corruption in the Ancient Hearth grows {0} quicker.
Effect_FasterFuelSacrifice_Desc: The Ancient Hearth seems to have a defect. No matter how hard the firekeeper tries, sacrificed resources are burning {0} quicker.
Effect_FasterFuelSacrifice_ShortDesc: Sacrifices in the Hearth cost more.
Effect_FasterLeaving_Desc: Villagers are less understanding than they used to be. They’re probably getting a bit spoiled by now. Villagers are {0} faster to leave if they have low Resolve.
Effect_FasterLeaving_ShortDesc: Villagers with low Resolve leave faster.
Effect_FedoraHat_Desc: An old inscription on the bottom of the hat says: "Fortune and glory". Increases the chance of doubling event loot by {0} (this doesn't apply to perks and blueprints).
Effect_FewerBlueprintsOptions_Desc: The greedy Royal Archivist sold most of the blueprints to traders and fled the Citadel. You have {0} fewer blueprint choices. You can gain an additional choice by spending <sprite name="[valuable] ancient tablet"> Ancient Tablets.
Effect_FewerCornerstonesOptions_Desc: The Royal Envoy comes to you with bad news. The Queen has restricted your cornerstone choices by {0}. You can gain an additional choice by spending <sprite name="hearth parts"> Wildfire Essence.
Effect_FewerInitialBlueprints_Desc: The Queen has visited the Obsidian Archives in person, and was dissatisfied with the amount of funding spent on expeditions. You have one fewer initial blueprint.
Effect_FewerInitialBlueprints_ShortDesc: One fewer blueprint to begin with.
Effect_FirstElderCat_Desc: From time to time, a weary villager stops to pet the cat, finding comfort in the reminder of their true home on the slopes of Red Mountain.
Effect_FishingSpeed_Desc: More durable and much wider nets. Fishing speed is increased by {0}.
Effect_FishmenFoodPoison_Desc: Fishmen are small and cunning enough to sneak into a settlement and poison the food supply. Villagers have a {0} chance of death after eating.
Effect_FishmenMysteries_Desc: Storm clouds seem softer. All Negative Forest Mysteries require a higher Hostility level (+{0}) to activate during the Storm.
Effect_FishmenNegativeMysteries_Desc: You begin to feel a growing anxiety. Something is changing in the aura. Negative Forest Mysteries require a lower Hostility level ({0}) to activate during the Storm.
Effect_FishmenOutpostResolve_Desc: Something is observing the villagers from the edge of the woods.
Effect_FishmenOutpostResolve_Hooked_Desc: With each fallen tree, the Fishmen grow closer. Global Resolve is hit by a {0} penalty for every {1} fallen trees.
Effect_FishmenSoothsayerCurse_Desc: The comforts of the civilized world are disgustingly unnatural to the Fishmen. Every time {0} Complex Food, Clothing, or Service needs are fulfilled, {1} random villagers are killed.
Effect_FishmenSoothsayerPlague_Desc: A powerful spell that feeds on the insatiable anger of the forest. Hostility is increased by {0} for every scout in your settlement. This includes idle scouts and workers assigned to this event.
Effect_FishmenTraps_Desc: Trying to enter the Fishmen cave triggers hidden traps. A Fishmen Totem spawns every {0} seconds.
Effect_FishmenWitchcraft_Desc: Fishmen witches have prepared a special surprise for anyone trying to break into the cave. Spawns {0} Fishmen Totems.
Effect_FoodProductionSpeed20_Desc: A handy set of notes on how to survive in the wilderness, written by an anonymous viceroy. Increases global food production speed by {0}.
Effect_FoodProductionSpeed50_Desc: All food production (both raw and cooked) is {0} slower.
Effect_ForbiddenforHostility_Desc: Securing the deadliest corners of the forest will make it a lot less terrifying. Completing a Forbidden Event (<sprite name="forbidden">) reduces the Hostility gained from Dangerous (<sprite name="dangerous">) and Forbidden Glades (<sprite name="forbidden">) by {0}, and from Small Glades by {1}.
Effect_ForbiddenforHostility_Old_Desc: Securing the deadliest corners of the forest will make it a lot less terrifying. Every discovered Forbidden Glade lowers the Hostility gained from Dangerous and Forbidden Glades by {0}, and from small glades by {1}.
Effect_FrighteningVisions_Desc: Horrific phantoms appear before the villagers. Get {0} to Global Resolve every {1} seconds.
Effect_FrogForUpgrade_Desc: Members of the Frog clan flock to your settlement. Gain {0} Frog villager for every {1} house upgrades.
Effect_FrogGracePeriod_Ability_Desc: Removes {0} Impatience Point, but after one season, you must pay the Crown {1} <sprite name="[valuable] amber"> Amber. Otherwise, you'll gain {2} Impatience Points.
Effect_FrogGracePeriod_Desc: The Crown can be persuaded to show leniency toward this settlement. Grants an Active Ability that removes 1 Impatience Point at the cost of 10 <sprite name="[valuable] amber"> Amber. Usable from the Main Warehouse, up to 5 times.
Effect_FrogNewcomerBonus_Desc: Frog firekeepers may not be the most skilled at fire rituals, but they are great leaders. Newcomers will arrive {0} quicker.
Effect_FuelRodActivation_Desc: You've gained access to <sprite name="[other] fuel rod"> Fuel Rods. Crafted at the Field Engineering Station, these volatile cells greatly amplify the power of Rain Engines.
Effect_FuelRodsNegative_Desc: Inserting a Fuel Rod will immediately spawn {0} Blightrot Cyst(s). Blightrot Cysts will also appear {1} faster while using this Rain Engine.
Effect_FuneralFeast_Hostility_Desc: The funeral guests are slowly departing, but their movement disturbs the forest. Hostility is increased by {0}.
Effect_FuneralFeast_Resolve_Desc: An aura of sorrow has befallen the town, with somber chants echoing from the Feast Hall.
Effect_FuneralFeast_WorkingSpeed_Desc: Life in the settlement seems to have slowed down. Scouts work {0} slower on glade events.
Effect_Gambler_RandomRaceFavoring_Desc: The Gambler seems to have a cruel sense of humor... Each season, a randomly selected species is favored.
Effect_GargoleHolstility_Desc: Villagers united in faith can lull the possessed demon back to sleep. Hostility is increased by {0}, but each villager with their Religion need fulfilled reduces it by {1}.
Effect_GargoleKillVillager_Desc: The vile spirit trapped within this statue must be purged, but it will require a sacrifice. Kills {0} random villager(s).
Effect_GargoyleDecoration_Desc: Rainwater production is increased by +1, and installing Rain Engines requires {0} fewer <sprite name="[mat processed] pipe"> Pipes.
Effect_GatherProductionSpeed50_Desc: An ominous aura is enveloping the forest. Gathering and woodcutting speeds are decreased by {0}.
Effect_Generic_GoodsRawProductionPenalty: All {0} production is reduced by {1} (whether from gathering, farming, or production).
Effect_Generic_ImpatienceFromEvent_Descr: Somehow, word of your decision has spread and reached the Queen. Viceroy executions are quite rare, but not as rare as you might hope. Gain 1 Impatience Point.
Effect_Generic_ImpatienceFromEvent_Many_: Somehow, word of your decision has spread and reached the Queen. Viceroy executions are quite rare, but not as rare as you might hope. Gain {0} Impatience Points.
Effect_GhostGoodsRemoval_Desc: Pain and suffering speak through the phantoms of the past. Destroys all stored {0}.
Effect_GhostHostility_Desc: The offended ghost has brought misfortune upon you. Hostility is increased by {0}.
Effect_GhostKill_Generic_Desc: The Restless Spirits want revenge, or they will never find peace. Kills {0} villagers ({1}).
Effect_GhostPartsLost_Desc: Pain and suffering speak through the phantoms of the past. Destroys 6 stored <sprite name="[mat processed] parts"> parts.
Effect_GhostRemoveSelf_Desc: If the ghost's request is not met in time, it will simply vanish.
Effect_GiftOfTheWoodlands_Desc: The Royal Woodlands are very lush and rich in timber. Trees give more <sprite name="[mat raw] wood"> wood.
Effect_GladeInfo_Airship_Desc: You can see the content of undiscovered glades.
Effect_GlobalReputationTresholdIncrease_: You took a very peculiar group of settlers with you. They seem perpetually dissatisfied. The Resolve threshold at which each species starts producing Reputation increases by {0} more point for every Reputation Point they generate.
More Resolve needed to gain Reputation.
Effect_GuildsDisfavor_Desc: The growing power of the Guild hasn't gone unnoticed. The Queen's Impatience grows by {0} every time goods worth {1} Amber are sold.
Effect_HardOrdersOnly_Desc: The Queen has decided to entrust you with the most difficult orders, as you are one of her most experienced viceroys.
Effect_HearthBonusHP_Desc: The Ancient Hearth's resistance to corruption is increased by {0}.
Effect_HearthCorruptionRate_Desc: Allows firekeepers to combat corruption more efficiently. Every burned cyst removes an additional {0} corruption.
Effect_HearthHP500_Child_Desc: Blightrot Cysts will take {0} more seconds to burn until you destroy at least {1} of them (source: {2}).
Effect_HearthHP500_Desc: A complicated runic structure, designed to shield the hearth from corruption. The Ancient Hearth's resistance to corruption is increased by {0}.
Effect_HearthRelicWorkingSpeed_Desc: Glade event work speed increased by {0}.
Effect_HigherBlueprintsRerollCost_Desc: The Archivist assigned to your settlement is fiercely loyal to the Royal Court, so bribing him will be more expensive. Blueprint rerolls cost {0} Amber more.
Effect_HigherNeedsConsumptionRate_Desc: Villagers have forgotten what a modest life looks like. They want to enjoy life to the fullest. Villagers have a {0} chance of consuming double the amount of service goods.
Effect_HigherTradersPrices_Desc: Traders gossip about you doing pretty well lately. All your goods are worth {0} less to traders.
Effect_HigherTradersPrices_ShortDesc: Goods are worth less to traders.
Effect_Hostility_Generic_Desc: The forest’s Hostility is temporarily increased by {0} points.
Effect_HostilityForCysts_Desc: Every {0} burnt Blightrot Cysts lowers Hostility by {1}.
Effect_HostilityforDangerousRelics_Desc: One who lives in harmony with himself lives in harmony with all. Every Glade Event solved by making a decision marked as Empathy lowers Hostility by {1}.
Effect_HostilityforDeath_Desc: The forest requires sacrifices. Hostility is reduced by {0} every time {1} villagers die.
Effect_HostilityForGladeTrader_Desc: The forest saw what you did, and it remembers. Hostility is increased by {0}.
Effect_Hostilityforrelics_Desc: Every Glade Event solved by making a decision marked as Loyalty lowers Hostility by {1}.
Effect_HostilityForTablets_Description: Archaeologists have learned how to decipher ancient tablets, and can now use that knowledge to appease the angry forest. You get {0} Hostility for every {1} in your settlement's Warehouse.
Effect_HostilityForTree_Desc: Woodcutting angers the dead. Hostility increases by {0} points for every {1} fallen trees.
Effect_HostilityForWater_Desc: Rainwater seems to soothe the forest. Hostility is reduced by {0} points every time you use {1} units of water in Rain Engines.
Effect_HostilityFromTermites_Desc: Agitated termites can be a real nuisance.
Effect_HostilityLower_Desc: A book by the renowned Stormwalker, Pervun Runebeak. Lowers Hostility by {0} points.
Effect_HPforImpatience_Desc: The Queen's grace knows no bounds. Every time you complete an order, a small abandoned cache will appear in your settlement.
Effect_HubsForHostility_Desc: Hostility is reduced by {0} for every Hearth upgraded to: {1} (or higher).
Effect_HubsForNewcomerGoods_Desc: Wealthy settlements attract wealthy settlers. Newcomers bring {0} more goods with them for every Hearth level gained.
Effect_HubTier_0_Desc: Gathered around the blazing fire, folks keep each other's spirits high. Global Resolve is increased by {0} and the Ancient Hearth's resistance to corruption is increased by {1}.
Effect_HubTier_1_Desc: Some viceroys say aesthetics don't matter out in the wilds, but you know better than that. Global production speed is increased by {0} and global Resolve is increased by {1}. The Ancient Hearth's resistance to corruption is increased by {2}.
Effect_HubTier_2_Desc: The town is booming with activity, and industry thrives. Workers have a {0} higher chance of producing double yields, and global Resolve is increased by {1}. The Ancient Hearth's resistance to corruption is increased by {2}.
Effect_HungerStorm_Desc: Missing even a single meal in this harsh climate can be deadly. If villagers don't have anything to eat during a break, they will gain two stacks of the Hunger effect.
Effect_ImpatienceForGlade_Desc: A famous Viceroy emblem passed down from generation to generation. Discovering a glade during the storm lowers Impatience by {0}.
Effect_Incantation_Desc: A powerful, necrotic curse. Burning Blightrot Cysts takes {0} more seconds. Hostility is increased by {1} points for every Wildfire Essence stored in the settlement's Warehouse.
Effect_Infected_building_production_for_: A curious invention used for extracting Amber from Blightrot Cysts. Every completely infected building (100% Blightrot) generates {0}, but also adds {1} Hostility.
Effect_Infestation_Desc: Blightrot becomes extremely aggressive. {0} Blightrot Cysts will spawn in the settlement. Each cyst increases Hostility by {1} points.
Effect_InstantEffectAddon: Activates every time work on the corresponding Glade Event is started. The effect won't be reversed once work is stopped.
Effect_InstantStorm_Desc: Disturbing the Stormbird's nest will instantly summon a storm, which will continue until your scouts have finished working on the event. (Active only when the corresponding Glade Event is being worked on, but canceling the work will not stop the storm)
Effect_InstantStorm_Stormforge_Desc: Summons a storm that will not end as long as your scouts are working on the event. Canceling the process will allow the storm to pass, yet it won't end a storm that is ongoing.
Effect_InstitutionCampsProduction_Descri: The ancient Lizard clans are excellent survivalists. They have mastered hunting and foraging like no others. All gathering camps produce a {0} greater yield. This bonus does not affect woodcutters and fishers.
Effect_InstitutionEffectAddon: Same building effects do not stack.
Effect_InstitutionGlobalExtraProduction_: Whether it's theater or martial arts, there's an inspiring show for everyone. The chance of producing double yields is increased by {0}.
Effect_InstitutionGlobalProductionRate_D: Regular baths improve everyone's well-being. Global production rate is {0} faster.
Effect_InstitutionMoreResolveFromMeat_De: Lizard tribes have a long tradition of both animal husbandry and meat preparation. All meat-based complex foods (jerky, skewers, pies, paste) give {0} more Resolve.
Effect_InstitutionResolveForComplexFood_: A rich diet is beneficial for your villagers' health. Gain +{0} to Global Resolve for every {1} times any complex food need is fulfilled (the bonus is added retroactively).
Effect_InstitutionSlowerLeaving_Descript: Every evening, villagers gather to talk, bathe, and strengthen their bonds with one another. Villagers with low resolve will leave the town {0} slower.
Effect_InstitutionSlowerSacrafice_Descri: There can be nothing more sacred than a flame in a world soaked with rain. For every {0} seconds spent sacrificing goods in the Ancient Hearth, Hostility is reduced by {1} (the bonus is added retroactively). Sacrificing multiple resources at the same time will progress this effect's timer faster.
Effect_KelpiesCharm_Desc: Villagers are under the spell of the Kelpie, controlled like marionettes. Every {1} seconds, {0} random villagers stop working and blindly walk toward the Kelpie where they hallucinate until the effect is gone.
Effect_LessFoodConsumption_Generic_Desc: Villagers have a {0} chance of not consuming food during a break.
Effect_LessNewcommers_Desc: The creatures of the forest are not enough for the warbeast, so it must find other, more easily accessible food sources. Every newcomer caravan arrives with {0} fewer villagers on board.
Effect_LightningCatcher_Desc: Some scholars are trying to capture and harness the power of lightning... but their experiments usually bring destruction instead. Lightning will turn {0} buildings into ruins.
Effect_LightningPayment_Penalty_Desc: If you don't deliver the required goods, 3 buildings will turn into ruins.
Effect_LocateGrass_Description: Reveals the location of {0} of the nearest patches of fertile soil
Effect_LocateSprings_Description: Reveals the location of {0} of the nearest geysers
Effect_LongerRelicsWorkingTime_Desc: Villagers are reluctant to venture into Dangerous Glades. Scouts work {0} slower on Glade Events.
Effect_LongStormTotem_Desc: Heavy clouds are gathering around the Sacrifice Totem. The storm’s duration is increased by {0}, while drizzle and clearance seasons are decreased by {1}.
Effect_LowerImpatienceReduction_Desc: The Queen expects a lot from a viceroy of your rank. Impatience falls by {0} points less for every Reputation Point you gain.
Effect_LowerImpatienceReduction_ShortDes: Impatience falls less on gaining Reputation.
Effect_MarshlandsGathererSpeed_Desc: The Marshlands are a gatherer's paradise. Gathering speed is increased by {0} for every {1} workers assigned to gathering camps.
Effect_MarshlandsGiantNodes_Desc: The Marshlands are home to enormous lifeforms. Giant gathering nodes can be found in Forbidden Glades (<sprite name="forbidden">). Each glade will have a different node.
Effect_MemoryoftheForest_Desc: Other viceroys tried to settle here before, and the forest still remembers their presence. Start with {0} Hostility points.
Effect_MesmerizingLight_Desc: A strange and evil light is coming from the top of the lighthouse. It mesmerizes the settlement's scouts, causing them to work {0} slower on Glade Events.
Effect_MetallurgicExperts_Desc: The caravan is composed of the finest smiths the Crown can spare. Increases the production speed of <sprite name="[metal] copper bar"> copper bars, <sprite name="[metal] crystalized dew"> crystalized dew, and all recipes that use metal ingots by {0}.
Effect_MineCarts_Desc: An automated minecart will help miners transport resources from the Mine to the Warehouse.
Effect_MissingCrudeWorkstation_Desc: Some half-witted fool lost the blueprint for the Crude Workstation. Start without the Crude Workstation, but with {0} of each building material.
Effect_MistwormFood_Desc: Where there is one mistworm, soon many more will follow. Destroys all stored food (both raw and cooked).
Effect_ModTreeEater_Desc: A pack of hungry Tree Grazers has been spotted nearby. One tree is eaten every {0} seconds, opening a maximum of {1} glades.
Effect_MoleEarthquake_Desc: Drainage moles are intelligent beings, but they can be very bad-tempered when hungry. Kills villagers and destroys all gathering nodes, buildings, and events within a {0} field radius.
Effect_MoleResolvePenalty_Composite_Desc: Villagers are afraid of going into the woods. All woodcutters, fishermen, and gatherers get a {0} penalty to Resolve.
Effect_Monolith_Desc: Making the right offering at the Obelisk reduces Hostility by {0} and increases the Ancient Hearth's resistance by {1}.
Effect_MoreAmberFromRoutes_Desc: Trade routes are worth {0} more <sprite name="[valuable] amber"> Amber. Doesn't apply to routes already in progress. This effect scales along with the quantity of goods exported.
Effect_MoreCharges_Desc: A deeper mine level has revealed new mining veins: {0}.
Effect_MoreCharges_StaticDesc: A deeper mine level has revealed new mining veins.
Effect_MoreResolveForComfortable_Desc: Workers who are assigned to a workplace that matches their comfort specialization receive an additional +{0} Resolve from the "Comfortable" effect.
Effect_MoreTradeOffers_Child_Desc: No trader will arrive in your settlement until you complete at least {0} trade routes. Traders currently staying in the settlement will leave immediately (source: {1}).
Effect_MoreTradeOffers_Desc: Big strategic changes always come with an adjustment period. Every neighboring town offers {0} more trade routes, but no trader will arrive in your settlement until you complete at least {1} trade routes. Traders currently staying in the settlement will leave immediately.
Effect_MushroomInFarms_Altar_Desc: All farms can plant <sprite name="[food raw] mushrooms"> Mushrooms (<sprite name=grade2>) on farm fields during drizzle season. Planting and harvesting crops is {0} faster.
Effect_MushroomInFarms_Desc: All farms can plant <sprite name="[food raw] mushrooms"> mushrooms ({0}) on farm fields during drizzle season.
Effect_Nocookingutensils_Desc: The caravan lost someone on the way, who unfortunately was carrying all the cooking equipment. All food recipes are {0} slower.
Effect_NoOrderChoice_Desc: The Queen is taking a close interest in your endeavors. You only get one non-timed order to choose from with each envoy visit.
Effect_NoPositiveSeasonalEffects_Desc: Due to extremely unfavorable conditions in these lands, there is no positive Forest Mystery.
Effect_Outbreak_Desc: The explosion of the machine will not only destroy everything within a {1} field radius, but will also cause {0} Blightrot Cysts to spawn in the settlement.
Effect_Overexploitation_Altar_Desc: Global gathering speed is increased by {0}, and newly discovered gathering nodes have more charges ({1}).
Effect_Overexploitation_Child_Desc: For every {0} gathering node charges used, {1} Blightrot Cyst(s) will spawn.
Effect_Overexploitation_Desc: Global gathering speed is increased by {0}, and newly discovered gathering nodes have more charges ({1}). {2}
Effect_Overflow_Desc: The broken machine is pumping rainwater into our tanks at an excessive speed, producing {0} water per minute. However, if the water level in the tanks reaches its maximum capacity, an overcharge will occur every {1} seconds, causing the death of {2} villager.
Effect_OverrideTraderMerch_Desc: All traders offer mystery boxes instead of perks and blueprints.
Effect_Parasites_Desc: One of the villagers was sick, and infected the rest of the settlement with a parasite. All villagers have a {0} chance of eating twice as much during their break.
Effect_PauseBlock_Desc: You are unable to use the pause function.
Effect_PermanentEffectAddon: This penalty is permanent and won't be removed once the corresponding Glade Event is finished.
Effect_Petrified Egg_Desc: No Stormbird will ever hatch from this egg, but it's still crackling with energy. Global production speed is {0} faster.
Effect_PetrifiedTreeHousing_Desc: Petrified wooden structures are slowly degrading. All homes can house {0} fewer resident.
Effect_PetrifiedTreeWoodcutting_Desc: A petrified tree is radiating its sickness onto the entire forest. Tree felling is {1} slower.
Effect_PitPony_Desc: Where machines can't tread, a pony will be sent. Strong workhorses help the miners and increase production speed by {0}.
Effect_PlagueOfBlindness_Desc: When they lost their sight, they lost all hope along with it. All villagers move {1} slower and have a {0} chance of destroying a production yield.
Effect_PlagueOfDarkness_Desc: Some say this is the beginning of the end. The storm season is {0} longer, and sacrificing goods at the Ancient Hearth is banned.
Effect_PlagueOfDeath_Desc: The Sealed Ones are thirsty for blood. Discover {0} Dangerous (<sprite name="dangerous">) or Forbidden Glades (<sprite name="forbidden">) during this storm. If you don't, {1} villagers will be killed in the coming drizzle season.
Effect_PlagueOfFire_Desc: Even the eternal rain cannot stop the ghastly fires coming from the abyss. Fuel in the settlement's warehouses is disappearing at a rate of {0} units every {1} seconds.
